faq.q1: How do I participate in a challenge?
faq.q3: How do I win a challenge?
faq.q6: What types of content can I submit?
faq.q11: Can I withdraw points as money?
faq.q13: How do I follow other creators?
faq.q14: How do I earn referral rewards?
faq.a0: A Challenge is a creative community where you can join original photo and video missions, share your work, and compete for listed rewards. A fresh challenge is published every week.
faq.a1: It's simple! Click on a challenge you like, take an original photo or video that matches the theme, add a caption if you want, and submit. You can edit your image with filters and stickers before posting.
faq.a2: A new batch of five challenges is prepared each week by our AI editor. Admins review the programme and can also create special or sponsored challenges.
faq.a3: At the end of each challenge, participants are ranked using the published criteria, including community response and rule compliance. Top creators earn recognition, points, and badges.
faq.a4: Current rewards are non-cash: points, badges, profile recognition, and occasional partner rewards that are clearly described on the challenge page. Points and badges have no cash value.
faq.a5: Points you earn by participating in challenges increase your level and unlock badges. The more you participate, the higher your level!
faq.a6: You can submit photos or videos depending on the challenge type. Make sure your content is original and matches the challenge theme.
faq.a7: Submissions are automatically verified. If your image appears to be AI-generated or taken from the internet, it will be rejected. Only original photos/videos that YOU created are accepted.
faq.a8: Once submitted, you cannot modify your entry. Make sure everything is perfect before submitting!
faq.a9: The leaderboard displays the Top 10 participants for each completed challenge. Ranking is based on: Likes × 2 + Comments. You can also see your own rank.
faq.a10: The final ranking is determined when the challenge ends. Eligible creators then receive the listed non-cash points, badges, recognition, or clearly announced partner reward.
faq.a11: No. A Challenge points and badges are recognition inside the community and cannot currently be exchanged or withdrawn as money.
faq.a12: If a challenge includes a partner reward, its eligibility and delivery details will be stated clearly on that challenge. No partner reward is implied unless it is explicitly listed.
faq.a13: Click on a creator's profile and press 'Follow'. You'll then see their submissions in your 'Following' feed.
faq.a14: Share your unique referral link (in the Referrals section). When someone signs up with your link, you earn rewards!
faq.a15: 1. Original content only (no AI, no internet). 2. Follow the challenge theme. 3. No offensive or inappropriate content. 4. One account per person.
faq.a16: Our AI automatically verifies each submission to detect AI-generated images or ones taken from the internet. Cheaters are banned.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what A Challenge collects, why it is used, and the choices available to you.
legal.privacy.s0.title: Controller and contact
legal.privacy.s0.p0: A Challenge is operated by Albi Lubila Mayamwene, who is the controller of personal data processed through the service. Contact details are provided above and in the site footer.
legal.privacy.s1.title: Information we collect
legal.privacy.s1.p0: We process account details, profile information, challenge submissions, moderation records, participation activity, and support communications that you choose to provide.
legal.privacy.s1.p1: Payment providers may process billing information. A Challenge should store only the provider identifiers and transaction records needed to operate purchases, rewards, and refunds.
legal.privacy.s2.title: Purposes and legal bases
legal.privacy.s2.p0: Information is used to operate accounts, publish entries you choose to share, rank eligible participation, prevent abuse, moderate content, administer rewards, improve performance, and meet legal obligations.
legal.privacy.s2.p1: Depending on the activity, processing is based on performing the service contract, compliance with legal obligations, legitimate interests in securing and improving the service, or consent where it is specifically requested. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.
legal.privacy.s3.title: Analytics and error monitoring
legal.privacy.s3.p0: A Challenge uses privacy-friendly Vercel Analytics, Speed Insights, and technical error reports. Error reports are limited, exclude email addresses when detected, and are used to diagnose failures and improve reliability.
legal.privacy.s4.title: Sharing, transfers, and retention
legal.privacy.s4.p0: Public profile fields and approved submissions can be visible to other visitors. Service providers such as Supabase, Vercel, payment processors, and email delivery providers process data only to provide the service.
legal.privacy.s4.p1: Where a provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, A Challenge relies on an applicable adequacy decision or approved safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.
legal.privacy.s4.p2: Account data is normally kept while the account is active and is then deleted or anonymised when no longer needed. Records may be retained longer where required for security, accounting, disputes, backups, or legal obligations.
legal.privacy.s5.title: Your data protection rights
legal.privacy.s5.p0: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing. You can edit profile information, remove optional content where the product allows it, or request account deletion.
legal.privacy.s5.p1: Requests can be sent to the email address above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO). Essential authentication storage is required to keep you signed in securely.
legal.privacy.s6.title: Children and international use
legal.privacy.s6.p0: Users who are below the age of digital consent in their country must use the service only with permission from a parent or legal guardian. Local privacy rights may vary by country.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro: By creating an account or submitting content, you agree to these terms and the applicable challenge rules.
legal.terms.s0.title: Account responsibilities
legal.terms.s0.p0: Provide accurate information, protect your login credentials, and notify A Challenge if you believe your account has been compromised. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.
legal.terms.s1.title: Original and lawful content
legal.terms.s1.p0: Submit only work you created or have permission to use. Do not submit illegal, deceptive, hateful, sexually exploitative, dangerous, privacy-invasive, or rights-infringing content.
legal.terms.s2.title: Licence to display submissions
legal.terms.s2.p0: You retain ownership of your work. By submitting it, you grant A Challenge a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to host, display, resize, moderate, and promote that submission in connection with the service and the relevant challenge.
legal.terms.s3.title: Moderation and enforcement
legal.terms.s3.p0: A Challenge may reject, hide, or remove entries and may restrict accounts that violate these terms, challenge rules, safety requirements, or applicable law. Material decisions may be reviewed when an appeal channel is available.
legal.terms.s4.title: Rewards and availability
legal.terms.s4.p0: Points, badges, titles, profile effects, and ranking recognition have no cash value and cannot currently be withdrawn or exchanged for money. A separately announced partner reward may have its own eligibility and delivery terms. Features, schedules, rewards, and availability may change, but published commitments will be handled fairly and transparently.
legal.terms.s5.title: Disclaimers
legal.terms.s5.p0: The service is provided on an as-available basis. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or liabilities that cannot legally be excluded in your jurisdiction.
legal.terms.s6.title: Governing law
legal.terms.s6.p0: These terms are governed by Polish law. If you are a consumer, this does not remove mandatory protections granted by the law of your country of residence. Disputes may be brought before a court with jurisdiction under applicable law.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie and Storage Policy
legal.cookies.intro: A Challenge keeps tracking deliberately small and uses browser storage only where it supports the service.
legal.cookies.s0.title: Essential storage
legal.cookies.s0.p0: Supabase authentication uses browser storage to maintain a secure signed-in session. Interface preferences may also be stored locally. Disabling essential storage can prevent login and personalised features from working.
legal.cookies.s1.title: Analytics
legal.cookies.s1.p0: Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights measure page usage and Core Web Vitals without building advertising profiles. A Challenge does not use third-party advertising cookies.
legal.cookies.s2.title: Your controls
legal.cookies.s2.p0: You can clear site data through your browser. Doing so signs you out and resets locally stored preferences. Browser privacy controls can also limit non-essential measurement.
legal.contest-rules.title: General Challenge and Contest Rules
legal.contest-rules.intro: These rules apply unless a challenge page publishes additional terms. If specific rules conflict, the specific challenge rules control.
legal.contest-rules.s0.title: Eligibility and entry
legal.contest-rules.s0.p0: No purchase is necessary. Enter before the published deadline using an eligible account. Age, country, format, and partner-reward restrictions may be specified on each challenge page. Minors need permission from a parent or legal guardian where required.
legal.contest-rules.s1.title: Originality and permissions
legal.contest-rules.s1.p0: Entries must be your original work. Obtain permission from identifiable people, location owners, and rights holders when required. AI-generated or materially AI-assisted content is allowed only when the challenge explicitly permits it and must be disclosed when requested.
legal.contest-rules.s2.title: Safety and fair play
legal.contest-rules.s2.p0: Do not endanger people, animals, property, or the public. Do not manipulate votes, create duplicate accounts, plagiarise entries, or misrepresent when or how work was created.
legal.contest-rules.s3.title: Judging
legal.contest-rules.s3.p0: Winners may be selected using the published criteria, which can include originality, execution, relevance, community response, and compliance. Engagement signals may be reviewed for fraud and are not automatically decisive.
legal.contest-rules.s4.title: Rewards
legal.contest-rules.s4.p0: Current platform rewards are non-cash points, badges, titles, profile recognition, or ranking features. They cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for money. If a challenge offers a separate partner reward, its description, eligibility, delivery timing, and any applicable tax responsibility will be stated on the challenge page or winner notice.
legal.contest-rules.s5.title: Disqualification and cancellation
legal.contest-rules.s5.p0: Entries that break these rules may be rejected. A challenge may be modified, paused, or cancelled when fraud, technical failure, safety, legal restrictions, or events outside reasonable control prevent fair operation.
